title: The Kite for the Spring Festival

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=20 beats='Tomas and Grandma Rosa decide to build a kite together for the spring festival just three days away.'>>

choices.label: Pick a kite design to build

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=45 beats='Grandma Rosa spreads three old patterns on the table, a box kite, a diamond kite, and a delta kite, and asks Tomas which to build and test first.'>>

choices.label: Build and test the box kite
Build and test the diamond kite
Build and test the delta kite

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=55 beats='Tomas and Grandma Rosa finish the red box kite and carry it to the test hill, where the wind keeps doing something different every few minutes.'>>

choices.label: It climbs steady and strong
A sudden gust flips it sideways
The paper tears clean through the corner

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=45 beats='The box kite climbs steadily above the test hill, and Tomas grins as the string tugs gently in his hand.'>>

choices.label: Try a victory loop right here
Carry it straight to the festival

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=45 beats='At the festival grounds Grandma Rosa points toward windy Lantern Hill on one side and the crowded festival field on the other.'>>

choices.label: Launch from Lantern Hill
Launch from the festival field

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=45 beats='The gust knocks the box kite flat in the grass, and Grandma Rosa asks Tomas how he would like to keep going.'>>

choices.label: Try again right away
Ask Grandma Rosa to just watch instead

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=45 beats='Tomas steadies the frame and gives the box kite one more careful toss into the wind.'>>

choices.label: It finally catches and climbs
It tumbles again, no matter what

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=20 beats='They set the box kite aside on the grass and walk together toward the festival grounds without it.'>>

choices.label: Find a spot to watch other kites

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=55 beats='Grandma Rosa and Tomas finish the blue diamond kite and carry it to the test hill, watching the wind shift again and again.'>>

choices.label: It climbs steady and strong
The wind suddenly dies down
The string tangles into a stubborn knot

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=45 beats='The diamond kite climbs steadily above the test hill, dipping and swooping in slow lazy circles.'>>

choices.label: Try a victory loop right here
Carry it straight to the festival

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=45 beats='The wind on the hill dies down completely, and Grandma Rosa asks Tomas how he would like to keep going.'>>

choices.label: Wait and try again right away
Ask Grandma Rosa to just watch instead

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=45 beats='Tomas holds the diamond kite steady and waits for one more careful gust to try again.'>>

choices.label: A fresh gust finally lifts it
The wind stays calm, no matter what

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=20 beats='They set the diamond kite aside on the grass and walk together toward the festival grounds without it.'>>

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=55 beats='Tomas and Grandma Rosa finish the yellow delta kite and carry it to the test hill, where the wind cannot seem to make up its mind.'>>

choices.label: It climbs steady and strong
The wind swirls it in dizzy circles
One strut bends and will not straighten

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=45 beats='The delta kite climbs steadily above the test hill, gliding smooth and fast in one long arc.'>>

choices.label: Try a victory loop right here

choices.label: It finally steadies and climbs

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='Without a kite to fly, Tomas and Grandma Rosa spread a blanket at the festival and spend the afternoon happily watching all the other kites drift overhead together.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='Right there on the test hill Tomas sends the kite into one perfect looping trick, and Grandma Rosa laughs and claps so hard that a few neighbors wander over to watch too.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='After one more careful try the kite finally catches the wind and climbs steady and true, and Tomas beams with pride at fixing the problem all on his own.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='On Lantern Hill the red box kite catches a strong, steady wind and soars high above the crowd while everyone below points and cheers.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='Down in the crowded festival field the red box kite dips between the food stalls and the flagpole, drawing laughs and applause from everyone nearby.'>>
